summary: Staff data engineer with 7 years designing PostgreSQL-backed ETL platforms, Apache Airflow orchestration, and Python REST services; recent work adding Kafka streaming and Docker packaging.

bullets.text: Own the Python REST API layer that exposes curated PostgreSQL datasets to 6 downstream product teams.
Rebuilt the core warehouse schema in PostgreSQL, adding partitioning that cut nightly load time in half.
Authored and maintained 30+ Apache Airflow DAGs covering ingestion, transformation, and reporting jobs.
Introduced Kafka topics for near-real-time event ingestion and packaged consumers with Docker.
